# HB-03 · Travel policy: private car use
version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-06-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-24

§1 Scope
This version set the mileage rate for all employees. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims.

§2 Standard mileage rate
Business kilometres driven with a private car are reimbursed at 36 cents per km. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment.

§3 Additions
For trips towing a trailer, 8 cents per km was added to the standard mileage rate. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred.

§4 Version status
This version applied from 2025-06-01 until the day before 2026-04-01. From 2026-04-01 it is superseded by HB-24; claims for earlier dates keep this version's amounts.

====
# HB-24 · Travel policy: private car use
version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-03

§1 Scope
This policy sets the mileage rate for all employees. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.

§2 Standard mileage rate
Business kilometres driven with a private car are reimbursed at 32 cents per km. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department.

§3 Additions
For trips towing a trailer, 8 cents per km is added to the standard mileage rate. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule.

§4 Approval and receipts
Claims follow the expense submission process. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. # HB-10 · Memo: mileage rate exceptions
version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01

§1 Purpose
This memo lists group exceptions to the mileage rate in HB-24. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted.

§2 Exception for electric vehicles
For electric vehicles, the mileage rate is 45 cents per km instead of the standard amount. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims.

§3 Carve-out
The exception above does not apply to electric rental cars; they follow the standard mileage rate in HB-24 §2. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred.

§4 Review
This memo is reviewed together with the main policy. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance

# HB-38 · Related budgets: private car use
version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01

§1 Scope
This document covers budgets related to, but separate from, the mileage rate. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule.

§2 Central budget
Company pool cars are charged to projects at an internal rate of 36 cents per km to cover fuel and maintenance. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.

§3 Contacts
The finance team answers questions about these budgets. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible.
